atomicity.reason: One obligation: accept the sustained charging power in the SoC window.

comprehensibility.reason: Value is held in the value field; self-contained.

feasibility.reason: MCS variant: 1000 kW sustained across 20-80 % SoC (about 1250 A at 800 V) without any temperature condition pushes against cell thermal and voltage limits the BMS enforces.
feasibility.suggestion: Add the battery temperature conditions under which the sustained power applies.

parent_fit.reason: A defined sustained charging power over 20-80 % SoC is what makes recharging within a driver break possible (US_FAST_DEPOT_CHARGING).

unambiguity.reason: 'Sustained ... up to the value' can be read as a peak capability or as an average over the window.
unambiguity.suggestion: Phrase as the minimum average power over the 20-80 % window.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated bev like the parent; product-specific value in a variant function <<mcs: 1000 kW, 350 kW>>.

verifiability.reason: 'Sustained' has no duration or tolerance, and the ambient / battery temperature conditions of the test are not given.
verifiability.suggestion: State the test conditions (battery temperature range, ambient) and what 'sustained' means (e.g. average power >= value -x % over the whole 20-80 % window).
